excerpt.zh: 建造于现有重力重定向系统之上，重力透镜设施能够使一部分力穿过“透镜”，将力更加密集地集中在某一片选中的区域。
excerpt.en: Built on the existing gravity redirection system, the Gravity Lensing Facility is able to redirect a portion of the force into a "Lens", concentrating the force even more strongly in a selected area.
